answer: Bonded forecast escrow resists sybils: an identity earns nothing for existing, only for being predicted well. Each head posts an ivory-collateral bond that peer agents bet against, and a random withhold audit each epoch demands a signed live output; any cluster that shares one funding address is slashed at the cluster level, not per head. A thousand fakes then cost a thousand locked bonds plus a single correlated loss, and a prism of rotating audits keeps staged personas hollow: the attacker pays per head while collecting nothing per head.
